name: Multiresolution LAO Pipeline
definition: A per-fragment processing pipeline that computes Local Ambient Occlusion (LAO) illumination for each voxel in the volume, driven by the multiresolution LOD selection. It uses the same data reduction as the volume LOD to accelerate processing.
summary: The Multiresolution LAO Pipeline is a per-fragment volume rendering method that computes ambient occlusion by incrementally processing light directions across multiple frames, leveraging multiresolution LOD selection to adapt sampling rates and accelerate computation.
